body: BOUNDED SPOT-CHECK — AMEND assertions 5, 7, and 8; assertions 3, 4, and 6 are faithful to exact a7fa64a. Assertion 3 matches the complete recall roster and bidirectional textual-twin contract, including unit id, ordinal, text, exact SpanSet, function, expressed uncertainty, and own-checksum evidence. Assertion 4 correctly preserves every P key, present zero versus absent/unavailable, faithful versus distorted facets, all six external provinces, fixed display policy, and unrenormalized remainder. Assertion 5 is correct only when the F-only foils remain validator-admissible with the same adjacent P marginals; if an arbitrary F mutation breaks those marginals, the frozen court requires refusal, not a changed rendered flow. State fixed-P, fixed-marginal F foils explicitly. Assertion 6 is exact: Viterbi is one identified model-relative MAP path, secondary to P/F, and row-absent states refuse. Assertion 7 partly widens a7fa: the exact court requires source kind, hierarchy, evidence, deterministic discourse rank, optional measured discourse position and story-world rank, plus typed relation identities when displayed; it does not require a page-crossing temporal/causal relation fixture. Keep pagination-only geometry invariance, but label that relation fixture as a deliberate E0 strengthening rather than a7fa conformance. Assertion 8 matches missing/imputed/refused/suppressed/present-zero and omission refusal only if term eligibility is rendered unavailable in this artifact; current CostBreakdown cannot establish ineligible. A stronger eligible-low-mass omission foil needs the separately checked universe/eligibility companion. No implementation or path authority.
